headline: Kids Program Robots to Speak Indigenous Languages
meta_description: Children are teaching robots to speak their Indigenous languages, blending technology with cultural preservation in a creative educational initiative.
summary_short: Young students are programming robots to communicate in their native Indigenous languages, merging technology with cultural heritage preservation.
body:
Children are taking the lead in a novel effort to preserve their Indigenous languages by programming robots to speak them. The initiative puts young learners in the role of teacher, using technology as a tool to document and strengthen their linguistic heritage.

By coding robots to recognize and reproduce their native languages, students engage in hands-on learning that connects digital skills with cultural pride. The project transforms technology education into an act of cultural stewardship, ensuring that Indigenous languages continue to live and evolve alongside modern tools.
